description: Espace de compensation: espaces verts et ouverts (importance bioclimatique) is published by SIG-GR. It describes a Luxembourg planning layer rating the bioclimatic importance of green and open spaces for nighttime cold-air supply. Coverage is national within LU. Spatial detail: 25 m input and model-result raster; layer portrayal may be generalised. Temporal coverage: 2018 base data; regional climate analysis published 2021. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Data format is not established in the metadata reviewed. The reuse licence is not stated in the metadata read. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. Use is bounded by the 2018 base data and the specific weak-wind summer radiation conditions of the Luxembourg climate analysis. The provider warns that combining layers can give misleading interpretations. This review identifies hazard exposure, capacity planning as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are data-openstreetmap. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
